about: The product facts of the Isotone Graphics Suite, stated once. A fact changes here first; scripts/drift-check.py then holds the README, every tracked text file, and the repository's settings on GitHub to this file (D00 T01 section 10). Versions are not copied here: `versions` names where each one is pinned. Each suite and app fact names its copies (`copies`: a file and a pattern that must match, or a path that must exist), so changing a fact here refuses every copy still stating the old one.

apps.name: Albumen
apps.role: Digital darkroom, photo manager, and fast image viewer

repository.description: Isotone Graphics Suite: free, open source Windows creative apps in native C++23. Stilus vector editor, Gesso raster editor, Albumen digital darkroom, Tinctura color studio, Capio screen capture, Folium page layout.

readme.opening_line: Six native Windows creative apps, one shared core: a vector editor, a raster editor, a digital darkroom, a color studio, a screen capture tool, and a page layout app.
